title: A behind-the-scenes look at Midjourney’s medical scanner leaves many questions unanswered
brief: Midjourney released a behind-the-scenes video of its medical ultrasound scanner, a novel device using multiple hacked-apart probes in a water tank to produce detailed imaging without radiation. The company plans to deploy the scanner in spas but has provided limited evidence of its clinical efficacy despite promoting it as transformative for medicine.
